stored.summary: No labor employed; see note 6 on maintenance.

stored.title: Gas
stored.summary: Common areas and units use no gas.

stored.title: Electric
stored.summary: Complete Condo Service Inc opinion (5/28/2024): ~2,190 KWH/yr at ~$0.30/KWH = $723, incl. 10% inflation and taxes; units individually metered.

stored.title: Water and Sewer
stored.summary: Complete Condo Service Inc opinion: $4.49/HCF water + $7.14/HCF sewer x 146.98 HCF/yr (40.27 CF/day) = $1,880.

stored.title: Repair, Maintenance and Supplies
stored.summary: Cleaning supplies/minor repairs via independent contractors as needed.

stored.title: Service Contracts
stored.summary: Fire alarm $1,500/yr (contract to be signed before first move-in); phone/cable/internet (Verizon, month-to-month) $1,000/yr; 2-unit building with small common area so no janitorial service, unit owners handle own refuse/entryway.

stored.title: Insurance
stored.summary: Jacob J Katz and Company estimate (10/8/2024), $3,213.87/yr premium: $1,500,000 building all-risk 100% RCV, rent loss up to 12 months, $1,000 deductible, liability $1,000,000 special form; excludes fidelity bond/rent insurance/excess.

stored.title: Management Fees
stored.summary: Board self-manages initially; outside management company would cost ~4-6% of gross common charges (min ~$600/month), raising common charges by at least 30%.
